# Lexora

> Lexora is a free, AI-powered word intelligence platform for Scrabble, crosswords, anagrams and word puzzles. It validates every word against the official TWL (US) and SOWPODS (UK) tournament dictionaries and returns ranked plays with real tile scores.

Lexora helps competitive and casual players find the highest-scoring Scrabble plays, solve crossword patterns with wildcards, unscramble any set of letters into every valid word, and browse curated lists of words by starting letter, ending letter, length and letter content. All tools work in the browser with no sign-up.

Primary use cases:
- Scrabble and Words With Friends players looking for the best play from a rack.
- Crossword solvers pattern-matching partial answers like `C?T??`.
- Wordle, anagram and word-puzzle enthusiasts unscrambling letters.
- Writers, teachers and students browsing dictionary word lists by pattern.

## Tools

- [Scrabble Solver](https://spuk.lovable.app/scrabble-solver): Enter your rack (blanks with `?`) and get every legal play ranked by tile score, with US/UK dictionary toggle and advanced filters (starts with, ends with, contains, min length).
- [Crossword Solver](https://spuk.lovable.app/crossword-solver): Pattern matcher for partial answers. Use `?` for unknown letters (e.g. `C?T??` returns CATCH, CITED, CUTUP).
- [Word Finder / Anagram Solver](https://spuk.lovable.app/word-finder): Unscramble any letters into every valid dictionary word, filterable by exact length. Supports blank tiles.
- [Words Hub](https://spuk.lovable.app/words): Index of every browsable word list on the site.

## Word Lists (programmatic)

- [Words starting with Q](https://spuk.lovable.app/words/starting-with/q): Every TWL-valid word beginning with the letter Q, grouped by length and scored.
- [Words ending in Y](https://spuk.lovable.app/words/ending-in/y): Every TWL-valid word ending in the letter Y.
- [5 letter words with A](https://spuk.lovable.app/words/5-letter-words-with-a): 5-letter words containing the letter A — useful for Wordle.
- [Unscramble LISTENING](https://spuk.lovable.app/unscramble/listening): Every word that can be made from the letters L, I, S, T, E, N, I, N, G.

Pattern of URLs (substitute any lowercase letter or letters):
- `/words/starting-with/{letter}`
- `/words/ending-in/{letter}`
- `/words/{n}-letter-words-with-{letter}` where `n` is 3–15
- `/unscramble/{letters}`

- [Every Q-Without-U Word Allowed in Scrabble](https://spuk.lovable.app/blog/words-with-q-no-u): Complete list of Scrabble-legal Q words that don't need U, with scoring setups.

- [How to Find Every Word From Letters](https://spuk.lovable.app/blog/words-from-letters): Systematic method for anagram solving.
- [Scrabble Bingo Strategy](https://spuk.lovable.app/blog/scrabble-bingo-strategy): Rack management, stem theory and probability behind 50-point bonuses.
- [Build a 10,000-Word Vocabulary](https://spuk.lovable.app/blog/build-vocabulary-word-games): Spaced repetition method using word games.

## Dictionaries

Lexora uses two tournament dictionaries as the source of truth:
- **TWL06 (Tournament Word List)** — the official Scrabble dictionary used in North America (~178,000 words).
- **SOWPODS / Collins Scrabble Words** — the international list used in the UK, Australia and most other countries (~279,000 words).

Tile values follow the standard Scrabble distribution: A/E/I/L/N/O/R/S/T/U = 1; D/G = 2; B/C/M/P = 3; F/H/V/W/Y = 4; K = 5; J/X = 8; Q/Z = 10.
